WITH date_dim AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_year, d_moy
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 2002
      AND d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
),
sales_customers AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk, 'store' AS sale_type
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT ws_bill_customer_sk, ws_sold_date_sk, 'web'
    FROM web_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON web_sales.ws_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cs_ship_customer_sk, cs_sold_date_sk, 'catalog'
    FROM catalog_sales
    JOIN date_dim ON catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
),
store_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk
    FROM sales_customers
    WHERE sale_type = 'store'
),
web_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS ws_bill_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM sales_customers
    WHERE sale_type = 'web'
),
catalog_sales AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT ss_customer_sk AS cs_ship_customer_sk, ss_sold_date_sk AS cs_sold_date_sk
    FROM sales_customers
    WHERE sale_type = 'catalog'
)
SELECT cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, count(*) AS cnt1,
       cd_purchase_estimate, count(*) AS cnt2, cd_credit_rating, count(*) AS cnt3
FROM (
    SELECT ca_address_sk
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_state IN ('IL','TX','ME')
) AS ca
JOIN customer c ON c.c_current_addr_sk = ca.ca_address_sk
JOIN customer_demographics ON customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk = c.c_current_cdemo_sk
WHERE EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ss.ss_customer_sk
      AND dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_dim dd ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE c.c_customer_sk = ws.ws_bill_customer_sk
      AND dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM catalog_sales cs
    JOIN date_dim dd ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
    WHERE c.c_customer_sk = cs.cs_ship_customer_sk
      AND dd.d_year = 2002
      AND dd.d_moy BETWEEN 1 AND 1+2
)
GROUP BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
ORDER BY cd_gender, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status, cd_purchase_estimate, cd_credit_rating
LIMIT 100
